title: Hanasato Minori — Debrief Assistance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We had another exhausting workout today.
Every part of my body feels sore...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But this pain is a sign of my growth!
I have to keep doing my best tomorrow to prepare for the Lumina Grand Prix!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
Before I forget, I need to write down what I need to work on in my notebook.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's see... What did I do today...?
Strength training, one-liners and some exercises on my own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (My posture got really bad every time I started feeling it during those strength exercises... So, my goal for tomorrow is gonna be to keep it steady!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (As for one-liners... I really struggled. I need to learn to be quicker on my feet and figure out how to be funnier.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But how do I actually become better?
Let's see... Airi recommended...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The best way to get better at coming up with one-liners is to play a word-association game in your head and construct sentences based on that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's take that first question, for example. “In a previous life, this cat was an idol! How could you tell?” I'd start by thinking about the words “cat” and “idol”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I'd take the words I came up with to construct various responses. “It winks whenever you point a camera at it,” or, “It poses whenever it's in a window's spotlight.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. I'll try coupling word-association with sentence building! She also said how it's funnier when you pair things that don't normally go together...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I still have some time before I have to go to bed, so let's start practicing!
<Start practicing what?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Good evening, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Luka! MEIKO!
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You were working very hard again today, weren't you? We came to see how you were doing...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. It sounds like your day isn't over quite yet.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't do so well during Airi's lesson on one-liners, so I was going over my mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <One-liners?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Airi showed me a way to get better, but I'm still having a lot of trouble...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It takes a great deal of creativity to come up with good one-liners. It's not something you can master overnight.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <She's right. I think you just have to practice a lot and figure out your own style.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But we'll be more than happy to help, so let's practice together♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! Thank you both so much!
In that case, would you mind coming up with questions for me?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You can count on us♪ Alright, here's your first question! This teacher's a former idol, and she's way too cute! What is she like?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! U-Uhh... What is she like?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Ah, you have a challenger.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It sounded like a fun question, so I decided to answer.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka, I wanna hear you answer!
“This teacher's a former idol, and she's way too cute! What is she like?”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Okay, who can answer this question?
Today, I'll pick... You, since you raised your hand so quickly♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. We are idols, after all.
A cute response is just as good as a funny one, no?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right...! I'm learning so much already!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Lemme try... “Idol” and “teacher”... Cute responses work, and so do funny ones... Hmm... Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What do I do...?!
My brain's starting to feel totally overloaded!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Why don't you start by saying the things that immediately come to mind? That should help.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, going with your gut may be the best option in your case.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You think so? Then... Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: At the start of every class, she always does her self-intro! Or... Oh, instead of bringing chalk, she accidentally brought a glow stick instead!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. That's it, Minori!
Keep adding tools to your chest just like that♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you both so much!
I think I have a better idea of what to do now!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<You're welcome.
We're glad we could help, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, before I forget, I need to write down the advice you two gave me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... This is the last page of my notebook. I need to go buy a new one tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's so admirable that you've been writing in your notebook every single day.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, how many notebooks have you gone through?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? I'm not sure... Gimme a second to count them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here we are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wow, so many...
There must be at least fifty.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, and you wrote in all of these, correct, Minori?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe.
There really are a lot when you look at it like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I keep finding new problems every day...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this stack of notebooks represents how much I've been training, how hard I've been trying and how much I've grown until now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I'm gonna keep trying harder and harder! Until this stack reaches the ceiling!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Good luck, Minori. We're always rooting for you.>
